name: China National Software & Service Company Limited
summary: China National Software & Service Company Limited stands as a prominent Chinese enterprise specializing in software solutions. Its comprehensive product range encompasses cutting-edge offerings like software-defined infrastructure, advanced computing platforms, intelligence platforms, collaborative ecological creation platforms, and a variety of application and security-focused products. The company also provides a suite of professional services, including digital transformation consulting, cybersecurity advisory and support, network communication integration, and ongoing operation and maintenance. Established in 1980, this Beijing-headquartered firm operates as a key subsidiary of China Electronics Corporation.
